page: Microsoft Azure E32s_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor operating at 4.2 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes a massive 480 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark testing, the E32s_v7 demonstrates strong multi-threaded capabilities and memory throughput. It achieved a strong rating in gzip single-threaded compression of 35.62 GB/sec and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression of 183.59 GB/sec. Static web serving throughput is also strong at 43.89 GB/sec. For AI workloads, the processor's Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512 support contribute to strong prompt processing speeds on medium 7B LLM models at 186.24 tokens/sec and strong text generation on small 135M models at 298.63 tokens/sec. Other metrics, such as stress-ng CPU performance and Redis SET operations at 51.24 million operations/sec, fall within the average range.

The primary tradeoff of the E32s_v7 is the complete absence of local storage, requiring external Premium Storage attachments for persistent data. However, its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation provide solid qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound enterprise workloads. This server is highly suited for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data analytics, and CPU-based machine learning inference tasks that leverage its Intel AMX and AVX-512 instruction sets.
